summary: New file skills/debug-loop-workspace/grade.py: a mechanical eval grader for debug-loop runs. It walks eval-*/{with_skill,without_skill,old_skill}/outputs directories, reads each run's response.md and git history in the project fixture, runs the pytest suite, and computes signals like whether a debug brief heading/fields were present, whether tests were committed before the fix, and suite pass/fail. It then branches per eval name (vague-login, traceback, trivial-typo, red-tests) to check task-specific behaviors (e.g. version- vs created_at-based selection, BOM-aware reads, typo fix without other changes, unchanged pricing assertions with Decimal/cents usage). Emits one JSON blob per run.

claims.text: sh() runs a shell command in a given cwd with a 120s timeout, returning a CompletedProcess even on exception
brief_checks() detects a 'debug brief' heading, counts symptom/repro/check field mentions, counts numbered list items, and checks for command-output evidence via regex
git_facts() returns per-commit subject and changed files via git log/git show
test_first() returns True if any non-baseline commit touches only files containing 'test' in the name
suite() runs 'python3 -m pytest tests -q' in the project dir and returns exit code plus last 300 chars of output
grade() errors out with 'no project directory' if outputs/project is missing, otherwise aggregates brief checks, commit facts, suite result, and eval-specific checks
For vague-login evals, it checks selection by version vs still by created_at, new test files added, and lines added to test_sessions.py relative to the fixture baseline
For traceback evals, it checks BOM-aware reads (utf-8-sig/\ufeff), masking via row.get('region...), and presence of a BOM regression test

For trivial-typo evals, it checks the typo is fixed, source is otherwise unchanged (byte-for-byte after reverting the fix), tests are unmodified, and counts extra test files and response.md line count

For red-tests evals, it compares assertion lines before/after test_pricing.py to flag any removed or edited assertions, and checks pricing.py for Decimal/cents usage vs still using plain round(float*...)
main() defaults to grading ROOT/iteration-1 and iterates eval-* dirs across with_skill/without_skill/old_skill configs, printing a JSON array

risks.note: FIXTURES is an absolute, machine-specific path (/Users/admin/...); the script will break if run on another machine or after the repo moves.
test_first() requires ALL changed files in a commit to contain 'test' in the name; a commit that adds a test alongside an unrelated renamed file would be misclassified as not test-first.

source_otherwise_unchanged compares src.replace('.strip()', '.stip()') to the fixture; if the fix touches formatting/whitespace elsewhere too it would falsely flag as changed, and conversely a coincidental '.strip()' elsewhere in source not related to the typo would be silently replaced too.
Each eval-specific branch repeats the same read/regex/compare pattern; could be factored, though this is a style note not a correctness risk.

least_confident: Whether the eval-name substring matching (e.g. 'vague-login', 'traceback', 'trivial-typo', 'red-tests') reliably maps to the actual eval directory names used elsewhere in the workspace, since only this chunk's code is visible and not the directory listing it's meant to match.
